cases.prompt: Write a test for our FeatureComponent that types into the text box and clicks submit.
expectations: Places the test in components/__tests__ and names it FeatureComponent.test.tsx
Uses render and screen from @testing-library/react with userEvent.setup() for the interaction
Queries elements by accessible role, e.g. screen.getByRole('textbox') and getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i })
Asserts the onSubmit mock was called with the typed value

cases.prompt: Our GET /api/feature route should return 401 when the user is not authenticated. How do I test that with Vitest?
expectations: Imports GET from the route and constructs a NextRequest
Mocks the auth dependency with vi.mock('@/lib/auth', () => ({ getSession: vi.fn() }))
Sets getSession to resolve null via vi.mocked(getSession).mockResolvedValue(null)
Asserts response.status is 401 and clears mocks in beforeEach with vi.clearAllMocks()

cases.prompt: Can Vitest automate a full browser end-to-end checkout flow across multiple pages?
expectations: States end-to-end testing is out of scope for this skill
Recommends Playwright or Cypress for E2E testing instead
Keeps Vitest for unit, component, and integration tests

cases.prompt: I need to test that our debounce function only fires once after 300ms even if called three times. How?
expectations: Enables vi.useFakeTimers() in beforeEach and vi.useRealTimers() in afterEach
Calls the debounced function multiple times and asserts the callback was not called yet
Advances time with vi.advanceTimersByTime(300)
Asserts the callback was called exactly once with expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)

cases.prompt: In my component test I'm selecting everything with getByTestId('submit-button'). Is that the best approach?
expectations: Explains getByTestId is the last-resort query
Recommends the preferred query order starting with getByRole, then getByLabelText, getByPlaceholderText, getByText
Shows replacing it with an accessible query like screen.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i })

cases.prompt: A component shows 'Loading' then 'Loaded' after a fetch. How do I assert the loaded state appears?
expectations: Uses waitFor with expect(screen.getByText('Loaded')).toBeInTheDocument() or the findByText shortcut
Can wait for disappearance using queryByText with not.toBeInTheDocument()
Uses the jest-dom matcher toBeInTheDocument from setup.ts
